column1: # EXP-R2-242 re-measurement of the ProGen3 lineage after the scored-span repair.
# What changed and why the numbers have to move. `src.transfer.progen3.scored_logits`
# and `n_to_c_target_rows` built the scored set from `labels[1:]` under a pad mask
# alone. `ProGen3BatchPreparer.prepare_clm` renders `<bos>` + `"1"` + sequence +
# `"2"` + `<eos>` and returns `labels` identical to `input_ids`, so that set
# contains three marker positions per record: `"1"`, `"2"` and `<eos>`. No other
# arm of the panel scores a marker -- ProGen2's direction marker is position 0 and
# is never a target, and ProtGPT2's, ZymCTRL's and ProteinGLM's renderings carry no
# terminal marker -- so the three positions entered ProGen3's per-token figure as
# an arm-specific term with no analogue on any arm it is read against. The scored
# span is now the residues, resolved from the `NON_RESIDUE_TOKENS` declaration both
# paths already consumed through `content_mask`. The rendering is unchanged: the
# ids fed to the model, and the labels the shift reads, are byte-identical, and
# only the mask moved.
# What is reproduced, exactly. The 8-block context-information design of
# EXP-R2-240: 8 blocks x 200 records, res 64-246, pool 4000, disjoint unigram over
# 4000 held-out records, `--cohort-draw-seed 20260728 --seed 20260727`,
# `--skip-truncation`, skips 0/7000/.../49000, and the same `--cohort-name`, so the
# cohort and reference digests must come back identical to the recorded ones -- a
# mismatch is a failure to reproduce the design and not a result. Stage 41 then
# runs over these 16 sidecars alone (CPU, seed 20260820, 2000 paired bootstrap,
# `--alpha-sweep 1.0`), and identification is the displacement-corrected lower
# bound above zero on all eight blocks, as before.
# The ProteinGym cells are EXP-R2-225's two rungs at the stage's own defaults the
# frozen `lookup.json` was produced at (`--variants 1000 --seed 20260807
# --batch-size 16`, bfloat16), re-scored because the scored span is an input to
# every summed log-likelihood. `wildtypes.json` is staged into each cell's own
# output directory before dispatch, digest-verified against this repository's copy
# (e080a37758e29c66...); it is an input beside a result and is not either cell's
# `expect`. Analysis is `43_second_stage_capability.py --wave protein_progen3`
# against a directory holding these two payloads and the frozen `lookup.json`.
# Provenance. TRANSFER_PYTHON is the same GPFS ct runtime the R240 cells ran under,
# so the two runs differ in the code change under test and not in the interpreter.
# PROGEN3_CHECKPOINTS resolves each rung's own directory: the 112M keeps the
# module's TRANSFER_PROGEN3_DIR default and the 3B is addressed at
# ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR}/progen3-3b.
